system.description:
• Effect: Use Fascinate while performing: all listeners make a Will save or are held in rapture, Incapacitated while you perform and until the end of their next turn after you stop. A creature that is attacked or sees an ally attacked may save again at once.
  • Affects up to 20 Levels of targets — lowest Level first
  • Affects any humanoid regardless of language
  • Scales: 40 Levels at 16th, 80 Levels at 19th, 160 Levels at 22nd
  • 22nd level: a held crowd may be given a Suggestion that lasts a week.
